🎬 Mr Inbetween (2018–2021) — Crime, Drama, Comedy
Ray Shoesmith is a professional hitman trying to balance two completely different lives. On one side, he is a loving father, brother, and friend who wants to maintain some sense of normality. On the other, he works as a ruthless criminal who is paid to hurt, intimidate, and kill people.
Ray’s biggest challenge is keeping these worlds separated. His work constantly puts him in dangerous situations, while his personal relationships require him to show patience, honesty, and compassion. As the consequences of his actions begin to affect the people around him, maintaining that balance becomes harder and harder.
The series explores morality, violence, family, loyalty, loneliness, and the contradictions within human nature. Ray is not presented as a simple hero or villain—he is someone capable of genuine kindness while also committing brutal acts, making every decision he makes more complicated.
More than just a crime series, Mr Inbetween is a dark and surprisingly emotional look at how someone tries to live an ordinary life while being deeply involved in an extraordinary and dangerous world. 🔥
💬 Do you think Ray can truly separate his family life from the life he lives as a hitman? 👇

source_details.synopsis: Mr Inbetween is an Australian dark comedy-crime drama television series which premiered on FX on 25 September 2018 in the United States, followed by Fox Showcase in Australia on 1 October 2018. The series is a serialisation of the 2005 feature film The Magician, which was created, written by and starred Scott Ryan as Ray Shoesmith, a hitman for hire balancing his criminal and personal lives. Ryan reprises his lead role and is also the writer for the series, while all episodes are directed by Nash Edgerton. The program was originally commissioned for FX Australia as its first original drama production, but instead launched in Australia on Showcase following the closure of FX Australia between
